region.niani.intro: Niani is the town of the mansa, ruler of Mali, set among millet fields and baobabs on the Sankarani river. Every ancestor is remembered here, griots sing of Sundiata, and smiths are respected and a little feared.
region.timbuktu.intro: Timbuktu stands where the Niger meets the desert. Caravans bring Saharan salt here, and in the Djinguereber and Sankore mosques scholars argue over manuscripts.
region.gao.intro: Gao is the old Songhai town on the broad Niger: Sorko fishermen and boatmen, cavalry and landing places. In time, rulers here will govern much of West Africa.
region.djenne.intro: Djenne is a mud-brick town on an island in the inland Niger delta. Every year the flood cuts it off from the world, and in its market the gold of the forest lands meets the salt of the desert.
